content:
<1>Admin account types and their privileges

<2>{{productName}} admin
workspace configuration, room creation and administration, ability to invite and manage users in {{productName}} and in virtual rooms, ability to manage access rights.

<3>Room admin
Room administration and archiving, user invitation and management. Several admins can be assigned to a room.

<4>User
Users can create and edit files in the room, but can't create rooms, manage users, or access settings.

comment.text: Tooltip content describing different admin account types and their respective privileges within {{productName}}. It uses numbered HTML tags for formatting and includes a variable for the product name.
